Description: Gain stability when you disable a foe. Deal increased strike damage while you have stability.

Name: Marching Orders
Description: Periodically gain Soldier's Focus. Hitting with a burst skill expends Soldier's Focus to grant might to nearby allies.

Name: Leg Specialist
Description: Immobilize a target when you cripple them with a skill. Deal increased strike damage to foes affected with movement-impairing conditions.

Name: Soldier's Comfort
Description: Soldier's Focus heals affected allies and grants them protection.

Name: Roaring Reveille
Description: Warhorn skills apply additional boons. Your concentration is increased.

Name: Empowered
Description: Deal increased strike damage for every boon on you.

Name: Warrior's Cunning
Description: Deal increased strike damage to foes above the health threshold. Also deal more damage to foes with barrier. Damage bonuses do not stack.

Name: Shrug It Off
Description: Use "Shake It Off!" when you use a healing skill. Removing a damaging condition from an ally heals them.

Name: Empower Allies
Description: While you are in combat, grant might to yourself and nearby allies each interval.

Name: Mending Might
Description: Applying might to an ally heals you.

Name: Martial Cadence
Description: Soldier's Focus grants boons to affected allies and removes conditions from them. Refresh Soldier's Focus when you swap weapons.

Name: Vigorous Shouts
Description: Shout skills heal allies. Gain healing power based on your power.

Name: Phalanx Strength
Description: When you grant yourself might, grant it to nearby allies as well.

Name: Versatile Rage
Description: Gain adrenaline on weapon swap.

Name: Crack Shot
Description: Your longbow, rifle, and harpoon gun weapon skill 1 attacks are enhanced.

Name: Warrior's Sprint
Description: Run faster while wielding melee weapons, and deal increased strike damage while you have swiftness. Movement skills break immobilization when used.

Name: Stalwart Focus
Description: Increase your incoming healing effectiveness and healing to other allies.

Name: Fast Hands
Description: Gain swiftness when swapping weapons in combat.

Name: Doubled Standards
Description: Banners grant resolution to allies when they are dropped. Pulsing boons applied through banners last longer.

Name: Destruction of the Empowered
Description: Deal increased strike damage per boon on your target.

Name: Brawler's Recovery
Description: Remove conditions when you swap weapons.

Name: Versatile Power
Description: Gain might on weapon swap. Burst skills gain reduced recharge.

Name: Axe Mastery
Description: Gain ferocity. Gain additional ferocity when wielding an axe. Axe skills gain reduced recharge and grant adrenaline when critically striking.

Name: Heightened Focus
Description: Gain quickness and recharge your Burst skills when you strike a foe that is below the health threshold. Gain increased outgoing healing when you strike with a Burst skill, based on adrenaline spent.

Name: Burst Mastery
Description: Burst skills deal more damage, grant swiftness, and restore a portion of adrenaline spent.

Name: Torch Proficiency
Description: You can wield torches in your off hand.

Name: Primal Rage
Description: Gain access to berserk mode and primal bursts.

Name: Smash Brawler
Description: When you hit with a Primal Burst skill, extend the duration of your berserk. Critical-hit chance is increased while berserk.

Name: Last Blaze
Description: When you use a rage skill, inflict burning on nearby enemies. [ sic ] Rage skills extend berserk longer.

Name: Savage Instinct
Description: Activating berserk mode breaks stuns and reduces incoming damage.

Name: Burst of Aggression
Description: Gain a burst of speed when entering berserk mode.

Name: Blood Reaction
Description: A percentage of precision is given as a bonus to ferocity and a percentage of power is given as a bonus to condition damage. These bonuses are doubled in berserk mode.

Name: Heat the Soul
Description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you use a Burst skill.

Name: Dead or Alive
Description: Heal yourself and gain Blood Reckoning when entering berserk mode.

Name: Fatal Frenzy
Description: Berserk mode increases power and condition damage.

Name: Bloody Roar
Description: Deal increased strike damage while in berserk mode. Gain resistance when entering berserk mode.

Name: King of Fires
Description: Increase the duration of burning you apply. Gain fire aura when you critically hit an enemy. Berserker skills detonate fire aura, damaging and burning nearby foes.

Name: Eternal Champion
Description: Gain stability and endurance when entering berserk mode. Traits that trigger when entering berserk mode also trigger when exiting berserk mode. You can now exit berserk mode early.

Name: Dagger Proficiency
Description: You can wield daggers in both hands.

Name: Spellbreaker's Conviction
Description: Maximum adrenaline is capped at 2 bars, and only level 1 bursts are available. Gain access to the Full Counter burst and Meditation skills.

Name: Pure Strike
Description: Deal increased critical-hit damage. This bonus is doubled against boonless foes.

Name: Guard Counter
Description: Gain protection after a successful Full Counter.

Name: No Escape
Description: Dazes and stuns inflict immobilize.

Name: Dispelling Force
Description: Dazes, stuns, pulls, knockdowns, knockbacks, and launches remove boons.

Name: Loss Aversion
Description: Removing boons from a foe deals damage and gives you adrenaline.

Name: Resilient Counter
Description: Full Counter grants resistance.

Name: Sun and Moon Style
Description: Gain bonuses for each dagger you equip: Main hand—Strike damage is increased versus foes with no boons. Off Hand— Heal for a percent of your outgoing strike damage.

Name: Attacker's Insight
Description: Gain Insight when disabling foes or removing boons. Full Counter refreshes all burst skills on hit. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt and fear.

Name: Enchantment Collapse
Description: Removing a boon from a foe causes all nearby foes to lose additional boons.

Name: Resolute Counter
Description: Full Counter heals and removes conditions from you.

Name: Magebane Tether
Description: Hitting with a burst skill casts Magebane Tether on your target if they are within range.

Name: Pistol Proficiency
Description: You can wield pistols.

Name: Gun X Sword
Description: Gain access to the Gunsaber as an alternate weapon set, but lose the ability to swap to other weapon sets during combat. Adrenaline is replaced with flow.

Name: Unseen Sword
Description: Strike nearby enemies and gain increased flow rate when swapping to the gunsaber.

Name: Sharp as the Wind
Description: Load your gunsaber with ammunition that inflicts damaging conditions, changing its properties. Burn nearby enemies and gain increased flow rate when swapping to the gunsaber.

Name: River's Flow
Description: Load your gunsaber with ammunition that supports allies, changing its properties. Grant boons to nearby allies and gain positive flow when swapping to the gunsaber.

Name: Dragonscale Defense
Description: Gain boons when entering Dragon Trigger.

Name: Unshakable Mountain
Description: Grant barrier to nearby allies when you convert a certain amount of flow into charges.

Name: Fierce as Fire
Description: Gain increased strike damage and condition damage for each round of ammunition spent.

Name: Lush Forest
Description: Using the first round of ammo on an ammunition skill reduces the recharge of all warrior skills. Does not affect the recharge of Unsheathe Gunsaber, Sheathe Gunsaber, and Dragon Trigger.

Name: Guns and Glory
Description: Gain ferocity for a short duration when you hit with an explosion. The effect stacks duration.

Name: Immortal Dragon
Description: Dragon Slash heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt. Gain protection to allies whenever you convert a certain amount of flow into charges.

Name: Unyielding Dragon
Description: Dragon Slash becomes unblockable and ignores blindness. Gain might whenever you convert flow into charges.

Name: Daring Dragon
Description: Dragon Slash has a lower maximum charge level and consumes more flow per charge, but its effectiveness per charge is increased. Grant boons to nearby allies when you use Dragon Slash.

Name: Rally the Valiant
Description: Gain access to chants and command skills. Gain motivation by using a chant or by using a burst skill while a refrain is active.

Name: Call to Action
Description: Gain motivation when you enter combat. If no refrains are active, automatically activate the refrain of Chant of Action.

Name: Calming Tongue
Description: Chant of Recuperation removes conditions from affected allies when activated.

Name: Liberating Liaise
Description: Chant of Freedom grants superspeed to affected allies when activated.

Name: Inspiring Implements
Description: Gain concentration. Gain adrenaline and motivation when you swap weapons. Motivation can only be gained while a refrain is active.

Name: Strengthening Stanzas
Description: Refrains grant bonus effects to you while they are active.

Name: Invigorating Tempo
Description: Heal yourself and gain adrenaline for each point of motivation spent.

Name: Reverberation
Description: Command echoes can trigger a second time.

Name: Unyielding Resolve
Description: Strike and condition damage dealt to you is reduced for each point of motivation you have.

Name: Feverish Pulse
Description: Using a chant reduces the recharge of your other chants and grants boon to affected allies.

Name: Brisk Pacing
Description: Deal increased damage based on your motivation level.

Name: Enduring Refrain
Description: Refrain effects of chants are stronger. Gain additional motivation when you activate a chant.

Name: Explosive Entrance
Description: Your first attack when entering combat explodes, dealing damage to nearby foes. This ability refreshes after a dodge roll.

Name: Grenadier
Description: Increase the blast radius of grenades. Using a healing skill casts Lesser Grenade Barrage.

Name: Short Fuse
Description: Gain fury when you hit a foe with an Explosion.

Name: Glass Cannon
Description: Strike damage dealt increases when above health threshold.

Name: Steel-Packed Powder
Description: Explosions cause vulnerability.

Name: Aim-Assisted Rocket
Description: Missile hits launch a rocket at your target. After enough rockets have been fired, an orbital strike is called instead. This trait has an internal cooldown.

Name: Explosive Temper
Description: Explosions grant stacking ferocity when they hit.

Name: Blast Shield
Description: Explosive Entrance grants barrier. Gain vitality based on a percentage of your power.

Name: Shaped Charge
Description: Deal increased strike damage for each stack of vulnerability on your target.

Name: Grand Entrance
Description: Explosive Entrance grants you resistance and increased critical-strike chance for a brief duration.

Name: Shrapnel
Description: Explosions have a chance to cripple and cause bleeding on hit.

Name: Big Boomer
Description: Deal increased strike damage to foes with a lower health percentage than you. Hitting with an Explosion heals you over a few seconds.

Name: Serrated Steel
Description: Critical hits have a chance to cause bleeding. Bleeding you inflict gains increased duration.

Name: Chemical Rounds
Description: Gain condition damage. Your pistol skills gain increased condition duration.

Name: Sanguine Array
Description: Gain might when you inflict bleeding on a foe.

Name: High Caliber
Description: You have an increased critical hit chance against foes within the range threshold.

Name: Hematic Focus
Description: Gain fury when you inflict bleeding on an enemy. Fury gives an increased critical-strike chance.

Name: Juggernaut
Description: Gain might while wielding a flamethrower. Might applied to you gains increased duration. Napalm grants you stability and a fire aura.

Name: Thermal Vision
Description: Gain expertise. Increase your outgoing condition damage when you inflict burning.

Name: No Scope
Description: Critical hits on foes within the range threshold have a chance to grant fury. Fury grants you ferocity.

Name: Modified Ammunition
Description: Deal increased strike damage for each condition on a foe.

Name: Heavy Metal
Description: Your critical-strike chance and critical damage are increased against foes that are below the health threshold.

Name: Sharpshooter
Description: Bleeding you inflict scales off of your power instead of your condition damage.

Name: Incendiary Powder
Description: Burning you inflict lasts longer, and your critical hits inflict burning.

Name: Cleansing Synergy
Description: Using a heal skill triggers a cleansing pulse around you.

Name: Over Shield
Description: Shield skills grant protection to nearby allies. Protection on you gains increased damage reduction.

Name: Automated Medical Response
Description: Grant regeneration to nearby allies when you use a healing skill's associated tool belt skill.

Name: Sapping Device
Description: Weaken enemies when you disable or immobilize them. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Reconstruction Enclosure
Description: Grant protection to nearby allies when you use a heal skill.

Name: Experimental Turrets
Description: Turret. Turrets create a reflective barrier when built and grant boons to allies around them on a regular interval.

Name: Soothing Detonation
Description: Heal nearby allies when using a tool belt skill.

Name: Mecha Legs
Description: Gain resistance when you dodge.

Name: Energy Amplifier
Description: Your power and healing power are increased while you have regeneration.

Name: Anticorrosion Plating
Description: When you grant protection to an ally, cleanse conditions from them.

Name: Bunker Down
Description: Create a proximity mine at your target's location and a med kit at your location when you disable an enemy.

Name: Medical Dispersion Field
Description: While in combat, a percentage of healing you apply to yourself is stored by your Medical Dispersion Field. Each interval, stored healing is spent to heal nearby allies.

Name: Hidden Flask
Description: Drink a Lesser Elixir B when struck while below the health threshold.

Name: Invigorating Speed
Description: When you gain swiftness or superspeed, you also gain vigor.

Name: Protection Injection
Description: Gain protection when you are disabled. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Health Insurance
Description: Increase your incoming healing effectiveness. Gain increased healing to others while using a med kit.

Name: Transmute
Description: Drink a Lesser Elixir C when you use a healing skill.

Name: Comeback Cure
Description: Grant regeneration when you remove a condition from an ally.

Name: Boiling Point
Description: Gain fury when you gain might at or above the threshold.

Name: Blast Zone
Description: Create a blast finisher at your location when you use a healing skill 's associated tool belt skill.

Name: Compounding Chemicals
Description: Heal yourself when you grant yourself a boon. Remove a condition from yourself when you use an elixir skill. Gain increased concentration.

Name: HGH
Description: Elixirs gain increased durations, and grant might.

Name: Equal and Opposite Reaction
Description: Gain quickness and stability when you disable an enemy.

Name: Chain Reactivity
Description: Gain barrier when you successfully finish a combo field with a leap or a blast. Every third successful finish grants you might and a larger barrier that is shared with allies.

Name: Optimized Activation
Description: Using tool belt skills grants vigor.

Name: Static Discharge
Description: Discharge a bolt of lightning whenever you use a tool belt skill.

Name: Reactive Lenses
Description: Activate Lesser Utility Goggles when using a healing skill.

Name: Power Wrench
Description: Reduce the recharge of your elite skill when you dodge.

Name: Mechanized Deployment
Description: Your tool belt skills gain reduced recharge. Tool belt skills remove conditions. Engage Photon Forge cannot activate this trait.

Name: Streamlined Kits
Description: Equipping an Engineering Kit creates an attack or spell and grants you swiftness.

Name: Lock On
Description: Striking a stealthed foe triggers Invisible Analysis. Disabling a foe triggers Controlled Analysis. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Takedown Round
Description: Deal increased strike damage while your endurance is not full.

Name: Excessive Energy
Description: Strike damage dealt is increased while you have vigor.

Name: Kinetic Battery
Description: Gain kinetic charges when you use a tool belt skill. At maximum, charges gain a burst of speed.

Name: Adrenal Implant
Description: Endurance regeneration is increased. Reduce the recharge of your tool belt skills when you dodge.

Name: Gadgeteer
Description: Gadget skills are more powerful.

Name: Hammer Proficiency
Description: You can wield hammers.

Name: Function Gyro
Description: You gain access to the function gyro, which replaces your tool belt skill 5. Gain access to Gyro skills.

Name: Gyroscopic Acceleration
Description: Well abilities have an increased area of effect and grant superspeed to nearby allies on their first pulse. Your function gyro also grants superspeed to allies when cast.

Name: System Shocker
Description: Disabling a foe grants barrier to nearby allies. Your function gyro dazes foes when cast. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Mass Momentum
Description: Gain might while you have stability. Your Function Gyro applies stability to allies when cast.

Name: Speed of Synergy
Description: Using a heal skill grants superspeed in a radius around you. Using a healing skill's associated tool-belt skill grants you personal superspeed.

Name: Rapid Regeneration
Description: Regenerate health while affected by swiftness or superspeed.

Name: Expert Examination
Description: Your function gyro grants protection to allies when cast. Using a healing skill's associated toolbelt grants protection to nearby allies.

Name: Object in Motion
Description: Deal increased strike damage while you have stability, swiftness, or superspeed. This damage increase compounds for each boon you have.

Name: Impact Savant
Description: A percentage of the strike damage you deal is converted into barrier.

Name: Ex Machina
Description: Function gyro has additional charges, no longer has a recharge penalty, and grants barrier to nearby allies.

Name: Kinetic Accelerators
Description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you successfully combo a field with a blast, leap, or whirl finisher. Your function gyro is now a blast finisher. Whirl finishers can only trigger this trait once per interval.

Name: Applied Force
Description: Gain stability when you gain might at or above the threshold. Might grants bonus power.

Name: Sword Proficiency
Description: You can wield swords in your main hand.

Name: Photon Projector
Description: Photon Forge replaces your tool belt skill 5. Gain access to Exceed skills.

Name: Light Density Amplifier
Description: Photon Forge reduces incoming damage but has increased passive heat generation.

Name: Prismatic Converter
Description: Deactivate Photon Forge converts conditions into boons based on your heat level.

Name: Solar Focusing Lens
Description: Your first few attacks after entering or exiting Photon Forge inflict burning and deal increased strike damage. This bonus is also granted if you overheat.

Name: Heat Therapy
Description: Gain health per unit of heat lost. This trait does not function while cooling due to an overheat unless Photonic Blasting Module is equipped.

Name: Crystal Configuration: Storm
Description: Photon Forge skill 1 now fires explosive projectiles, but generates extra heat.

Name: Crystal Configuration: Eclipse
Description: Corona Burst grants a barrier for each target struck.

Name: Crystal Configuration: Zephyr
Description: Holo Leap removes movement-impairing conditions, grants superspeed instead of swiftness, and inflicts cripple.

Name: Laser's Edge
Description: While Photon Forge is active, your outgoing strike damage is increased based on your current heat.

Name: Thermal Release Valve
Description: Dodge rolling vents heat as an attack against nearby foes and grants vigor. (Attack will not occur without heat.)

Name: Enhanced Capacity Storage Unit
Description: Increases maximum heat capacity. While above 100% heat, periodically gain might. Some skills and traits gain additional heat tiers.

Name: Photonic Blasting Module
Description: Overheat now blasts damage to nearby foes and no longer deals its initial damage to you. The tool belt recharge penalty for Overheat is reduced. Heat can only be lost after overheating. Damage over time from Overheat is still applied.

Name: Mace Proficiency
Description: You can wield maces in your main hand.

Name: Mechanical Genius
Description: Through your mechanical genius, you have utilized Canthan jade technology to build a customized battle mech that will fight at your side. Your mech inherits a percentage of all of your combat attributes except precision, which is added to its own. Your tool belt skills are replaced with Mech Commands, customized by your trait choices. Mech Commands take longer to recharge when  using them far away from your mech. Gain access to signet utility skills.

Name: Mech Arms: Single-Edge Cutters
Description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Rolling Smash. Your mech's attacks apply bleeding. This attack's effect may only affect a certain target once per interval.

Name: Mech Arms: High-Impact Drivers
Description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Explosive Knuckle. Your mech's attacks now generate might for allies within a radius. This effect may only occur once per interval. The mech does not count against the target count for this trait.

Name: Mech Arms: Jade Cannons
Description: Melee attacks become ranged, have an increased chance to critically hit, and apply vulnerability. Unlocks the Mech Command skill Spark Revolver.

Name: Mech Fighter
Description: New combat subroutines enable your mech to use Rocket Punch when you activate Skill 3 on your equipped weapon. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own toughness and vitality stats.

Name: Mech Frame: Conductive Alloys
Description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Discharge Array. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own condition damage and expertise stats.

Name: Mech Frame: Channeling Conduits
Description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Crisis Zone. When you or your mech apply barrier, also grant a boon to the affected target. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your concentration and healing power stats.

Name: Mech Frame: Variable Mass Distributor
Description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Core Reactor Shot. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own precision stats.

Name: Exigency Protocols
Description: When your mech is struck while under half health, it activates Exigency Protocols, gaining damage reduction and regeneration for a short duration. Regeneration boons you apply are stronger.

Name: Mech Core: Jade Dynamo
Description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Jade Mortar. Mech Command skills grant you quickness when used and have a reduced cooldown.

Name: Mech Core: Barrier Engine
Description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Barrier Burst. While in combat, your mech will automatically grant a small barrier each interval to nearby allies. The mech does not count against the target count for this trait.

Name: Mech Core: J-Drive
Description: Gain access to the Mech Command skill Sky Circus. While dismissed or away for repairs, your mech supports you with an occasional aerial bombardment. Signet skills gain improved passive effects and continue to grant their passive bonuses while recharging.

Name: Experimental Union
Description: Through asuran ingenuity, you are host to a mercurial mold. You are able to command it using selectable morph skills that replace your toolbelt skills or even fully merge with it to evolve into a superior being. Morph skills selected will alter the composition of the mercurial mold, changing the bonuses it grants you when you evolve. Gain access to stance utility skills.

Name: Stainless Steel
Description: Convert conditions to boons when you use a stance skill or evolve.

Name: Innervating Alloy
Description: Heal every second while you have barrier. Heal when you evolve.

Name: Hardened Chrome
Description: Morph skills and evolving grant protection to yourself.

Name: Hybrid Vigor
Description: Gain vitality. Gain barrier when you use a morph skill.

Name: Carbolic Composition
Description: Amalgam skills inflict poison on hit. Poison you inflict lasts longer.

Name: Mercurial Tendencies
Description: Disabling an enemy reduces the cooldown of Evolve.

Name: Silver Lining
Description: Evolve no longer inherits bonuses from strains. Morph skills grant their strain bonuses.

Name: Willing Host
Description: Using a morph skill increases your damage for a duration.

Name: Symbiotic Synergy
Description: Evolve recharges morph skills. Morph skills deal increased strike damage.

Name: New Genes
Description: Morph skills grants boons to allies. Grant an additional boon based on which morph skill was used.

Name: Double Helix
Description: Evolve has two charges and grants an increased attribute bonus.

Name: Opening Strike
Description: You and your pet inflict vulnerability with your first strike when entering combat.

Name: Stoneform
Description: Use Lesser Signet of Stone when you use an elite skill. Activating a Signet grants might and fury.

Name: Hunter's Gaze
Description: Gain might when you strike a foe based on their health percent.

Name: Clarion Bond
Description: Cast Lesser Call of the Wild when you swap pets.

Name: Alpha Focus
Description: Your opening strikes inflict cripple on your foes.

Name: Wolfsong
Description: Canine Beast abilities apply vulnerability and reveal nearby enemies. You deal additional increased strike damage against vulnerable enemies.

Name: Farsighted
Description: Ranger weapon skills deal increased strike damage. Damage is further increased for foes above the range threshold.

Name: Moment of Clarity
Description: Gain an attack of opportunity for you and your pet on interrupting a foe. Daze and stun durations that you inflict last longer. This trait can only grant an attack of opportunity against enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

Name: Precise Strike
Description: Opening Strike has an increased chance to critically strike.

Name: Predator's Onslaught
Description: You and your pet deal increased strike damage to disabled, defiant, or movement-impaired foes. Affected conditions are stun, taunt, daze, cripple, fear, immobilize, and chilled.

Name: Remorseless
Description: Regain opening strike whenever you gain fury. Opening strike deals more damage.

Name: Lead the Wind
Description: Your longbow and harpoon-gun skills pierce and recharge faster. Point-Blank Shot grants boons.

Name: Tail Wind
Description: Gain swiftness when swapping weapons in combat.

Name: Sharpened Edges
Description: You and your pet have a chance to cause bleeding on critical hits.

Name: Primal Reflexes
Description: When you successfully evade an attack, gain vigor.

Name: Trapper's Expertise
Description: Increase the duration of boons and conditions applied by traps. Offensive traps inflict cripple.

Name: Furious Grip
Description: Gain fury when swapping weapons in combat.

Name: Fang and Claw
Description: Feline, avian, and drake pets gain additional precision and ferocity. Beast skills grant fury around the ranger.

Name: Strider's Strength
Description: You and your pet gain power. Gain additional power while wielding a sword. Successfully evading an attack grants might.

Name: Hidden Barbs
Description: Bleeding you inflict is more dangerous.

Name: Hunter's Tactics
Description: You deal more damage and have an increased chance to critically strike while attacking from behind or the side or when striking a defiant foe.

Name: Quick Draw
Description: When swapping weapons, gain quickness. The next ranger weapon skill you use will recharge faster.

Name: Light on your Feet
Description: Damage and condition duration are increased after dodging or using a ranger skill that evades. Short bow skills pierce and gain recharge reduction, and their attacks from behind or while flanking or against defiant foes are improved.

Name: Vicious Quarry
Description: Fury grants ferocity and additional increased critical strike chance. When struck while below the health threshold, gain fury.

Name: Natural Vigor
Description: You recover endurance more quickly.

Name: Child of Earth
Description: Create muddy terrain when you use a healing skill.

Name: Oakheart Salve
Description: Gain regeneration when you are inflicted with bleeding, poison, or burning. While you have regeneration, you take reduced strike damage.

Name: Arachnophobia
Description: Spider pet's Spit and devourer pet's Twin Darts additionally inflict torment. You and your pet gain expertise ; spiders and devourers gain more.

Name: Companion's Defense
Description: You and your pet gain protection when you dodge roll.

Name: Ambidexterity
Description: Gain condition damage. Gain additional condition damage while wielding a torch, dagger, or mace. Torch and dagger skills recharge faster.

Name: Survival Instincts
Description: Gain increased outgoing strike damage and reduced incoming strike damage. When above the health threshold, outgoing strike damage is further increased. When below the health threshold, incoming strike damage is further reduced.

Name: Empathic Bond
Description: Remove conditions when you swap pets.

Name: Rugged Growth
Description: You and your pet recover health while affected by protection.

Name: Carnivore
Description: Steal health from enemies when you or your pet disable them. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Wilderness Knowledge
Description: Survival skills grant fury and remove conditions.

Name: Poison Master
Description: Upon using a Beast ability, your pet's next attack will inflict poison ; your poison damage is increased.

Name: Rejuvenation
Description: Beast skills now grant regeneration around the ranger.

Name: Bountiful Hunter
Description: You deal increased strike damage for each boon affecting you. Your pet deals increased strike damage for each boon affecting it.

Name: Wellspring
Description: Grant regeneration to nearby allies when you use a healing skill. You and your pet gain healing power based on power.

Name: Allies' Aid
Description: Cast "Search and Rescue!" when you begin reviving an ally. Moa pets grant barrier to nearby allies with their Beast skill.

Name: Fortifying Bond
Description: When you gain a boon, it is shared with your pet.

Name: Evasive Purity
Description: Cleanse a condition when you dodge. Heal if you cleansed a condition this way.

Name: Spirited Arrival
Description: Grant boons to nearby allies when swapping pets.

Name: Windborne Notes
Description: Grant nearby allies regeneration when you use a warhorn skill. Heal allies when you grant them regeneration.

Name: Lingering Magic
Description: You and your pet gain increased concentration. Regeneration you apply is more effective.

Name: Nature's Vengeance
Description: Spirits slam again when they finish shaking.

Name: Protective Ward
Description: Cast Lesser "Guard!" when you swap pets.

Name: Invigorating Bond
Description: Beast skills heal allies around the ranger.

Name: Pack Alpha
Description: Your pet 's attributes are improved and pet skills gain recharge reduction. Improved attributes are power, condition damage, precision, toughness, and vitality.

Name: Go for the Eyes
Description: Nearby foes are blinded by Beast abilities.

Name: Natural Healing
Description: Your pet recovers health each interval.

Name: Resounding Timbre
Description: Commands copy boons from yourself to your pet. Soulbeast : when merged, extend the duration of boons on yourself instead.

Name: Loud Whistle
Description: While your health is above the threshold, your pet deals increased strike damage. Your pet swap gains recharge reduction.

Name: Wilting Strike
Description: Beast abilities inflict weakness on those struck. This effect will only occur once on each target struck by an ability.

Name: Bestial Rage
Description: Gain might and fury when you disable a foe.

Name: Honed Axes
Description: You and your pet gain ferocity. Axe skills gain reduced recharge, and you gain additional ferocity while wielding an axe.

Name: Pet's Prowess
Description: Your pet moves faster and deals more damage on critical hits.

Name: Beastly Warden
Description: Beast abilities taunt nearby foes. Ursine and porcine pets deal increased damage and have increased health.

Name: Zephyr's Speed
Description: Cast Lesser Quickening Zephyr when you swap pets.

Name: Go for the Throat
Description: When you strike an enemy with a Beast ability, cast Lesser "Sic 'Em!" on the enemy.

Name: Staff Proficiency
Description: You can wield a staff.

Name: Celestial Being
Description: Gain access to Glyphs. Become a celestial avatar once you gain enough astral force. Generate astral force by healing allies and damaging foes.

Name: Druidic Clarity
Description: Becoming a celestial avatar removes conditions from you and nearby allies.

Name: Verdant Etching
Description: Glyphs heal nearby allies. While in celestial avatar form, grant protection instead.

Name: Blood Moon
Description: Inflict bleeding on enemies you immobilize or disable.

Name: Live Vicariously
Description: When you heal an ally, you are also healed.

Name: Celestial Shadow
Description: Grant superspeed and stealth to nearby allies when leaving celestial avatar form.

Name: Grace of the Land
Description: Grant boons to allies within the radius of your Celestial Avatar skills.

Name: Natural Balance
Description: Upon entering and leaving celestial avatar form, deal increased condition damage and increased condition duration for a brief period.

Name: Natural Mender
Description: Increase healing to other allies. Gain astral force each interval while not in celestial avatar form.

Name: Cultivated Synergy
Description: When you use a healing skill, heal around your pet and create a water field attached to them. When you combo a water field with a blast finisher, sprout a Lesser Seed of Life at the location.

Name: Lingering Light
Description: While in Celestial Avatar form, your healing of others is significantly increased. Healing another player with a Celestial Avatar skill reduces the cooldown of Celestial Avatar. Cooldown can only be reduced once per outgoing heal and will occur even if the affected player is at full health.

Name: Eclipse
Description: Your Celestial Avatar skills are offensively augmented. Striking enemies grants additional astral force.

Name: Dagger Proficiency
Description: You can wield a dagger in your main hand.

Name: Elevated Bond
Description: Gain access to Stances. Survival in the desert has enhanced your connection to your pet, granting you the ability to meld with them by entering beastmode. Traits that affect your pet may affect you differently while in beastmode.

Name: Fresh Reinforcement
Description: Entering beastmode grants you the boons affecting your pet.

Name: Live Fast
Description: Using a Beast ability grants you offensive boons.

Name: Unstoppable Union
Description: Entering or exiting beast mode grants protection.

Name: Furious Strength
Description: You deal increased strike damage while you have fury.

Name: Second Skin
Description: Conditions inflict less damage to you while you have protection.

Name: Essence of Speed
Description: Gaining quickness increases the duration of other boons affecting you.

Name: Predator's Cunning
Description: When you apply poison to a foe, steal some health from them.

Name: Twice as Vicious
Description: Disabling a foe increases your damage and condition damage for a short duration.

Name: Eternal Bond
Description: Heal when you use a merged skill. You can swap pets while merged.

Name: Leader of the Pack
Description: Stance skills gain increased duration on you and grant their effects to nearby allies for a reduced duration.

Name: Oppressive Superiority
Description: Deal increased damage to foes at a lower health percentage than you. Conditions you apply to foes at a lower health percentage than you last longer.

Name: Hammer Proficiency
Description: You can wield hammers.

Name: Unleashed Power
Description: Gain access to Cantrips and Unleash. While your pet is unleashed, its skills are replaced with larger area-of-effect skills. Once per interval, Unleashed Ambush skills become available for a short period of time after you unleash.

Name: Debilitating Blows
Description: Disabling a foe applies conditions to that foe based on your current state. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Nature's Shield
Description: Cantrips grant barrier to you and your pet.

Name: Blinding Outburst
Description: Venomous Outburst deals more damage and applies blindness in addition to its other effects. Unleashed Ambush skills deal more damage.

Name: Natural Fortitude
Description: Gain vitality. Unleashed Ambush skills siphon health if they hit. Siphon healing is reduced for each target struck beyond the first. Cannot siphon the same target more than once per skill.

Name: Enhancing Impact
Description: Disabling a foe grants you boons based on your current state. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Cleansing Unleash
Description: Remove conditions when you or your pet unleash.

Name: Corrupting Vines
Description: Rending Vines corrupts boons into conditions instead of removing them. Unleashed Ambush skills remove boons from enemies. Cannot affect enemies more than once per skill.

Name: Vow of the Untamed
Description: Your outgoing strike damage is increased while you are unleashed. You take reduced damage from strikes while your pet is unleashed.

Name: Let Loose
Description: Unleashed Ambush skills grant boons to nearby allies. Refresh Unleashed Power when you swap weapons.

Name: Biorhythm
Description: When you or your pet unleash, gain biorhythm every interval for a duration. When you reach the biorhythm stack threshold, the next time you or your pet unleash, gain both bonuses from Vow of the Untamed.

Name: Ferocious Symbiosis
Description: You and your pet grant each other increased damage and movement speed when striking enemies. When this triggers, it refreshes the duration of all stacks

Name: Teachings of the Tengu
Description: Mastery of tengu wind magic allows you to conjure the Cyclone Bow at will. Using arrow -consuming skills grants Wind Force. After you reach the Wind Force threshold, you are able to use Hawkeye. Gain access to Squalls. Using Cyclone Bow skills consumes arrows. You generate arrows every interval.

Name: Joy of Movement
Description: Squalls remove movement -impairing conditions and a damaging condition.

Name: Feel the Rush
Description: Movement skills grant you swiftness and endurance.

Name: Wuthering Wind
Description: After using Bluster, your pet 's next attack creates a damaging swell of wind around its target.

Name: Bird of Prey
Description: Strike damage is increased when you have swiftness or superspeed. Swiftness is more effective.

Name: Flock Together
Description: Feathered pets have increased strike damage and health. Beast skills grant quickness around the ranger.

Name: Perilous Skies
Description: Quarry's Peril is replaced by Pelt.

Name: Thrill of the Catch
Description: Restore arrows when you or your pet disable an enemy.

Name: Jetstream
Description: Your base movement speed is increased. Hawkeye grants superspeed.

Name: Cloudburst
Description: Quarry's Peril and Supersonic Arrow reset the cooldown of Bluster. When you use Bluster or Hawkeye, grant boons to nearby allies.

Name: Gale Force
Description: Wind Force grants stacking increased movement speed and damage. When you use Hawkeye, convert these into a stronger bonus for a duration.

Name: Shrike
Description: After a number of missile hits, release a volley of arrows at your target and gain an arrow. Missiles from this trait do not count toward its next trigger.

Name: Serpent's Touch
Description: Stealing inflicts poison. While in the downed state, your attacks apply poison.

Name: Dagger Training
Description: Gain bonus power, which is increased when wielding a dagger.

Name: Mug
Description: Deal damage and gain life when stealing. This attack cannot critically hit enemies.

Name: Deadly Ambition
Description: Inflict poison when striking a foe with a dual wield attack. Gain increased condition damage. Applies poison once per attack use.

Name: Lotus Poison
Description: Gain might and weaken targets when you poison them.

Name: Even the Odds
Description: Apply vulnerability when you steal. Apply conditions when you hit with a stealth attack.

Name: Panic Strike
Description: Immobilizing a foe poisons them. Striking a foe with unique conditions equal to or more than the threshold immobilizes them.

Name: Revealed Training
Description: Gain power, then gain extra power while you are revealed.

Name: Exposed Weakness
Description: Deal increased strike damage to your target for each unique condition on them.

Name: Potent Poison
Description: Poison you inflict has increased damage and duration. Other Deadly Arts traits apply additional stacks of poison.

Name: Improvisation
Description: Use stolen skills twice. Reduce the cooldown of all equipped utility skills when you steal. If you are a Specter, gain additional shadow force while using Siphon on an enemy. Cooldown effect will only trigger if all utility slots are filled and if at least one of your active utility skills is on cooldown. Does not affect inactive sequence skills.

Name: Executioner
Description: Deal increased strike damage when your target is below the health threshold.

Name: Keen Observer
Description: Critical-hit chance is increased while your health is above the threshold.

Name: Assassin's Fury
Description: Gain might when you gain fury.

Name: Signets of Power
Description: Signets grant initiative.

Name: Twin Fangs
Description: Deal increased critical damage, which is further increased when your health is above the threshold. Gain bonus critical-hit chance when hitting a foe from behind or the side or when they are defiant.

Name: Unrelenting Strikes
Description: Grant fury to yourself and nearby allies when you critically strike an enemy.

Name: Sundering Shade
Description: Stealth Attack skills inflict vulnerability and grant fury upon successfully hitting foes.

Name: Practiced Tolerance
Description: Gain ferocity based on your precision.

Name: Deadly Aim
Description: Your pistol and harpoon gun attacks now pierce and have increased strike damage.

Name: Ferocious Strikes
Description: Gain increased critical damage against foes whose health is above the threshold.

Name: No Quarter
Description: Landing a critical hit while under the effects of fury increases the duration of fury. Gain increased ferocity while under the effects of fury.

Name: Hidden Killer
Description: Gain bonus critical-hit chance while stealthed. This bonus lingers for a short duration after you've been revealed.

Name: Invigorating Precision
Description: You are healed for a percentage of outgoing critical-hit damage. This healing is increased while you are under the effects of fury.

Name: Merciful Ambush
Description: Heal when you enter or exit stealth. Stealth yourself and your target when reviving an ally. This effect also applies to stealth you grant to allies.

Name: Shielding Restoration
Description: Grant barrier and dark aura to nearby allies when you use a healing skill.

Name: Shadow's Embrace
Description: Remove conditions when you enter or exit stealth. This effect also applies to stealth you grant to allies.

Name: Hidden Thief
Description: Stealing inflicts blindness. Stealth Attacks inflict weakness. Cannot affect the same target more than once per interval.

Name: Meld with Shadows
Description: Gain superspeed when you enter or exit stealth.

Name: Shadow Savior
Description: Gain dark aura when you steal. Granting yourself dark aura heals nearby allies.

Name: Leeching Venoms
Description: Venom utility skills siphon life from struck foes. Gain stacks of Spider Venom when you enter or exit stealth. Siphoning can only occur once per strike.

Name: Cloaked in Shadow
Description: Gaining stealth blinds nearby foes. Blinding a foe siphons health from them.

Name: Shadow Siphoning
Description: Stealth attacks siphon health if they hit. Cannot siphon the same target more than once per interval.

Name: Cover of Shadow
Description: When you steal, create a field around yourself that grants allies protection. Granting dark aura to yourself removes a condition from nearby allies.

Name: Shadow's Rejuvenation
Description: Gain initiative when you enter or exit stealth.

Name: Rending Shade
Description: Steal boons from enemies you strike with stealth attacks. Striking a boonless foe with a stealth attack breaks their barrier instead.

Name: Expeditious Dodger
Description: Gain swiftness upon dodging.

Name: Instant Reflexes
Description: Gain evasion when you use an elite skill.

Name: Pumping Up
Description: Gain might when when you dodge.

Name: Pain Response
Description: Dodging removes a damaging condition from you.

Name: Feline Grace
Description: Gain vigor upon successfully evading an attack.

Name: Guarded Initiation
Description: Movement skills grant resistance.

Name: Swindler's Equilibrium
Description: Gain power and additional power while wielding a sword or underwater spear. Successfully evading an attack while wielding a sword or underwater spear recharges Steal.

Name: Hard to Catch
Description: Gain endurance when you shadowstep.

Name: Fluid Strikes
Description: Gain increased strike damage for a period of time when you shadowstep or use a movement skill.

Name: Assassin's Reward
Description: Heal yourself whenever you use a skill that uses initiative. Heal yourself for each point of initiative spent.

Name: Upper Hand
Description: Gain initiative when you dodge, and gain initiative and regeneration when you evade an attack. Evading can only trigger this trait once per interval.

Name: Don't Stop
Description: While you have swiftness, movement-impairing conditions have reduced duration. When you gain swiftness, lose a movement-impairing condition.

Name: Kleptomaniac
Description: Stealing gives you initiative.

Name: Uncatchable
Description: Leave behind lesser caltrops when you dodge.

Name: Burst of Agility
Description: Use Lesser Haste when attacking a foe from behind or from the side or when they are defiant.

Name: Thrill of the Crime
Description: When you Steal, you and all nearby allies gain fury, might, and swiftness for 10 seconds.

Name: Preparedness
Description: Increases maximum initiative by 3. Gain increased expertise.

Name: Bountiful Theft
Description: Stealing grants you and all nearby allies vigor. You rip boons from your target and grant them to nearby allies. Grant additional boons to allies if your target has no boons.

Name: Trickster
Description: Tricks remove conditions.

Name: Pressure Striking
Description: Enemies you interrupt are inflicted with torment. This trait can only affect enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

Name: Lead Attacks
Description: Increases all damage dealt per initiative spent. Steal gains reduced recharge time.

Name: Quick Pockets
Description: Gain initiative on swapping weapons while in combat.

Name: Sleight of Hand
Description: Stealing also dazes the target. Reduces the recharge of Steal.

Name: Deadly Ambush
Description: Stealing also applies bleeding. Bleeding you inflict deals more damage.

Name: Staff Proficiency
Description: You can wield a staff.

Name: Physical Supremacy
Description: Gain access to physical skills. Your maximum endurance threshold is increased.

Name: Marauder's Resilience
Description: Gain vitality based on a portion of your power. Damage is decreased from foes within the range threshold.

Name: Escapist's Fortitude
Description: Gain health when you successfully evade an attack. Remove a condition whenever you evade an attack.

Name: Brawler's Tenacity
Description: Physical skills grant endurance when activated.

Name: Weakening Strikes
Description: Your next attack after dodging causes weakness to foes struck. Weakened enemies deal less damage to you, and you deal increased strike damage to them.

Name: Staff Master
Description: While wielding a staff, gain endurance for each initiative point spent. Gain bonus power, which is increased when wielding a staff.

Name: Havoc Specialist
Description: Strike damage dealt is increased when your endurance is not full.

Name: Impacting Disruption
Description: Recharge steal and inflict a pulmonary impact when you interrupt an enemy. This trait can only affect enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

Name: Endurance Thief
Description: Gain endurance when you successfully steal from an enemy.

Name: Lotus Training
Description: Your dodge ability now uses Impaling Lotus, firing daggers at nearby enemies. Gain increased condition damage for a period of time when dodging.

Name: Unhindered Combatant
Description: Your dodge ability is replaced by a long-range dash that removes inhibiting conditions and grants swiftness and damage reduction. Removing conditions in this way temporarily reduces endurance gain.

Name: Bounding Dodger
Description: Your dodge ability is replaced by Bound, dealing damage to the area after you evade. Gain increased strike damage for a period of time after you dodge.

Name: Rifle Proficiency
Description: You can wield rifles.

Name: Deadeye's Gaze
Description: Steal is replaced with Deadeye's Mark, which unlocks new Stolen skills and malice generation. Stealth attacks consume malice for bonus effects. Gain access to rifles and cantrips.

Name: Malicious Intent
Description: Marking a target or striking your mark with a stealth attack will immediately grant malice.

Name: Collateral Damage
Description: Trigger Burst of Shadows at your target's location if it dies while marked.

Name: One in the Chamber
Description: When you cast a cantrip, gain a random new stolen skill. Stolen skills deal more damage. (Requires a marked target. Overwrites existing stolen skills.)

Name: Renewing Gaze
Description: Deadeye's Mark recharges if your mark is defeated. Gain regeneration when this recharge occurs.

Name: Silent Scope
Description: Gain precision. When you dodge roll, gain access to your stealth attack if your malice is above the threshold.

Name: Payback
Description: When Renewing Gaze triggers, this trait restores a portion of the recharge time needed by your healing, utility, and elite skills. Excludes racial skills.

Name: Premeditation
Description: Deal increased strike damage for each unique boon you have; concentration is increased.

Name: Iron Sight
Description: Strike damage dealt to your marked target is increased, and strike damage taken from your marked target is reduced.

Name: Maleficent Seven
Description: Increase the maximum malice -stack count. Restore initiative and gain boons upon reaching the maximum number of malice stacks.

Name: Be Quick or Be Killed
Description: Gain quickness when marking a foe. Your power and precision are increased while under this effect.

Name: Fire for Effect
Description: Using a stolen skill grants additional boons to allies around you. Stolen skills will always be Steal Time, regardless of the target's profession.

Name: Scepter Proficiency
Description: You can wield scepters in your main hand.

Name: Specter
Description: Unlock scepter. Steal becomes Siphon. Gain access to shadow force through spending initiative, and gain access to Shadow Shroud ability.

Name: Second Opinion
Description: A portion of condition damage is converted to healing power. Gain condition damage, which is increased while wielding a scepter.

Name: Shallow Grave
Description: Transfer conditions to an enemy when targeting them with Siphon. Remove conditions from nearby allies and your targeted ally when targeting them with Siphon.

Name: Consume Shadows
Description: Gain stacks of Consume Shadows at regular intervals while in Shadow Shroud. Exiting Shadow Shroud consumes your remaining shadow force and heals allies based on the number of stacks you have gained. Allies that are fully healed receive the rest of the value in barrier.

Name: Dark Sentry
Description: Apply Rot Wallow Venom to allies you grant barrier to. Outgoing healing to allies is increased. Rot Wallow Venom effect cannot apply to yourself.

Name: Larcenous Torment
Description: Steal health and gain shadow force when you torment a foe. Does not grant shadow force while in shroud.

Name: Amplified Siphoning
Description: Gain increased shadow force when hitting a foe with Siphon. Grant increased barrier when targeting an ally.

Name: Traversing Dusk
Description: Heal allies in the area around you when you shadowstep. Gain shadow force for each ally in the radius. Wells grant resistance on their initial impact.

Name: Panaku's Ambition
Description: Gain barrier when you strike foes with a stealth attack. When you apply stealth to allies you also grant them barrier. This effect can only be received once and will reset when stealth is removed.

Name: Strength of Shadows
Description: Gain expertise based on a percentage of your vitality. Torment you inflict deals increased damage.

Name: Hungering Darkness
Description: While in shroud, transfer conditions from your tethered ally and cleanse conditions from yourself. Each condition removed in this fashion heals a percentage of your base health and grants your tethered ally barrier.

Name: Shadestep
Description: Shadow Shroud skills provide additional supportive effects to nearby allies and your tethered ally.

Name: Trinket Collector
Description: Steal is replaced with Skritt Swipe, allowing you to pilfer from enemies. Successfully pilfering grants one offensive and one defensive artifact. Only one artifact may be used each time you pilfer, and pilfering overrides any artifacts you already have.

Name: Card Swap
Description: Gain access to Reshuffle. Remove conditions from yourself whenever you reshuffle your artifacts or use an artifact skill.

Name: Repeat Ransacker
Description: Reduce the recharge of Skritt Swipe whenever you use an artifact.

Name: Prolific Plunderer
Description: Gain an additional artifact slot. Whenever you pilfer, you gain an additional, random artifact. You can use one additional artifact when you pilfer with Skritt Swipe.

Name: Magpie's Defense
Description: Grant yourself barrier when you use a healing or elite skill. The cooldowns for this trait are separate for healing and elite skills.

Name: Scoundrel's Luck
Description: Gain Scoundrel's Luck whenever you use Skritt Swipe, Scoundrel's Luck allows you to use Double Edge skills on cooldown without backfiring.

Name: Meticulous Custodian
Description: Your artifacts have increased effectiveness.  Beneficial artifact effects last longer.

Name: Exhilarating Ephemera
Description: Gain increased damage for a period of time after using an artifact.

Name: Enterprising Aristocrat
Description: Gain initiative and barrier whenever you use an artifact skill. You take reduced strike and condition damage whenever you have barrier.

Name: Prodigious Pincher
Description: You pilfer after using a certain amount of initiative. This trait will override any existing artifacts when triggered.

Name: Possessive Hoarder
Description: Artifacts grant boons to allies when used. Offensive and defensive artifacts grant different boons. Barrier granted through Magpie's Defense and Enterprising Aristocrat is now also granted to allies as well.

Name: Combat High
Description: Gain Combat High when you use Skritt Swipe, increasing your outgoing strike and condition damage. Lose stacks of Combat High every interval.

Name: Empowering Flame
Description: Gain power while in fire attunement.

Name: Burning Precision
Description: Burning you inflict has increased duration and your critical hits gain a chance to inflict burning.

Name: Conjurer
Description: Gain fire aura when an ally picks up a conjured weapon.

Name: Burning Fire
Description: Cast Lesser Cleansing Fire when you have a number of conditions on you.

Name: Sunspot
Description: Gain a fire aura, and damage nearby foes when you attune to fire. Also triggers on overload skills.

Name: Burning Rage
Description: Sunspot inflicts burning, and its radius is increased. Your condition damage is increased.

Name: Smothering Auras
Description: Fire auras have increased duration. Applying auras to allies removes conditions, and transmuting auras removes conditions from nearby allies.

Name: Power Overwhelming
Description: While at or above the might threshold, gain increased power. Power bonuses are doubled while attuned to fire.

Name: Pyromancer's Training
Description: Your fire -weapon skills gain reduced recharge. Deal increased strike damage to burning foes.

Name: Persisting Flames
Description: Fire fields created by weapon skills last longer. Whenever your fire fields hit a foe or you inflict burning, gain increased strike damage for a duration.

Name: Pyromancer's Puissance
Description: Gain might for using any skill while attuned to fire. When leaving fire attunement or successfully completing a fire overload, unleash a Flame Expulsion.

Name: Inferno
Description: Burning you inflict scales off of your power instead of your condition damage.

Name: Zephyr's Speed
Description: Your chance to critically strike is increased. While attuned to air, your movement speed is also increased.

Name: Zephyr's Boon
Description: Grant boons to allies you grant auras to.

Name: One with Air
Description: Gain superspeed when attuning to air.

Name: Ferocious Winds
Description: Gain ferocity based on your precision.

Name: Electric Discharge
Description: Strike your target with a bolt of lightning when attuning to air. Also triggers on overload skills.

Name: Inscription
Description: Gain boons upon casting a glyph based on your attunement. Gain resistance when attuning to air.

Name: Raging Storm
Description: Critically striking a foe grants fury. Gain ferocity while under the effects of fury.

Name: Stormsoul
Description: Deal increased strike damage to disabled or defiant foes. Outgoing stun duration increased. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Aeromancer's Training
Description: Gain ferocity, and gain additional ferocity while attuned to air. Air weapon skills get a reduced recharge time.

Name: Bolt to the Heart
Description: Deal increased strike damage to enemies below the health threshold.

Name: Fresh Air
Description: Recharge air attunement on a critical hit. Gain a ferocity boost when attuning to air.

Name: Lightning Rod
Description: Cast Lightning Rod when you disable a foe. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Stone Flesh
Description: Strike damage taken is reduced while attuned to earth.

Name: Earth's Embrace
Description: Gain resistance after using a healing skill.

Name: Serrated Stones
Description: Bleeding you inflict has increased duration. Deal increased damage to bleeding foes.

Name: Elemental Shielding
Description: Auras you grant to allies also grant protection.

Name: Earthen Blast
Description: Gain barrier and cripple nearby foes when attuning to earth. Also triggers on overload skills. Barrier will not be gained when attuning to the same element.

Name: Strength of Stone
Description: Gain condition damage based on your toughness. Inflict bleeding when you immobilize a foe. Bleeding can only occur on the same target once per interval.

Name: Rock Solid
Description: Grant stability to nearby allies when attuning to earth. Note: This effect will not trigger when attuning to the same element.

Name: Earthen Blessing
Description: Decrease the duration of movement-impairing conditions applied to you. Restore endurance when you receive one of these conditions.

Name: Geomancer's Training
Description: Strike damage from nearby foes is reduced. Earth weapon skills gain reduced recharge.

Name: Diamond Skin
Description: Remove conditions from yourself when you successfully combo a field with a leap finisher. Remove conditions from nearby allies when you successfully combo a field with a blast finisher.

Name: Written in Stone
Description: Signets continue to grant their passive bonuses while recharging. Gain an aura when you use a signet skill.

Name: Stone Heart
Description: You take reduced strike damage for a duration of time after entering or exiting earth attunement. Remaining effect duration is lost when exiting.

Name: Soothing Mist
Description: You and nearby allies recover health while you are attuned to water.

Name: Soothing Ice
Description: Gain regeneration and frost aura when using a healing skill.

Name: Piercing Shards
Description: Vulnerability you inflict has increased duration. Deal increased strike damage to vulnerable foes. Damage bonus is doubled while attuned to water.

Name: Stop, Drop, and Roll
Description: Dodging removes burning and chilled from nearby allies.

Name: Healing Ripple
Description: Heal nearby allies when attuning to water. This effect will not trigger when attuning to the same element, but will be triggered by overload skills.

Name: Soothing Disruption
Description: Cantrips grant boons.

Name: Cleansing Wave
Description: Remove conditions from nearby allies when attuning to water.

Name: Flow like Water
Description: Deal increased strike damage, which is further increased while your health is above the threshold. Blocking or evading an attack heals you.

Name: Aquamancer's Training
Description: Increase healing to other allies. Water -weapon skills gain reduced recharge.

Name: Cleansing Water
Description: Cleanse conditions from allies you grant regeneration to.

Name: Powerful Aura
Description: Any aura you grant yourself is granted to nearby allies.

Name: Soothing Power
Description: Gain vitality. Soothing Mist is more effective.

Name: Arcane Prowess
Description: Gain boons when you switch attunements.

Name: Arcane Precision
Description: Your critical strikes have a chance to inflict a condition based on your attunement.

Name: Renewing Stamina
Description: Gain vigor when you critically strike a foe.

Name: Arcane Restoration
Description: Swapping attunements restores health.

Name: Elemental Attunement
Description: Grant a boon to nearby allies when changing attunements. Note: This effect will not trigger when attuning to the same element.

Name: Arcane Resurrection
Description: Cast Geyser when you begin reviving a downed ally. Geyser now partially revives downed allies. When you begin reviving an ally, you gain an aura based on your attunement.

Name: Elemental Lockdown
Description: When you disable a foe, gain a boon based upon your current attunement.

Name: Final Shielding
Description: Cast Lesser Arcane Shield when you use an elite skill.

Name: Elemental Enchantment
Description: Gain concentration and your attunements gain reduced recharge.

Name: Evasive Arcana
Description: Cast a skill when you dodge based on your attunement.

Name: Arcane Lightning
Description: Arcane skills grant increased ferocity and have additional effects.

Name: Bountiful Power
Description: Gain charges when changing attunements. Gain a burst of power when you reach the maximum number of charges.

Name: Warhorn Proficiency
Description: You can wield the warhorn weapon.

Name: Singularity
Description: Attain elemental singularity by remaining in an attunement for a period of time. Upon attaining singularity, you may overload the attunement to your vicinity. Gain access to Shouts.

Name: Gale Song
Description: Grant protection to nearby allies when you use a healing skill.

Name: Latent Stamina
Description: Grant vigor to nearby allies when attuning to water. Restore endurance to allies you grant vigor.

Name: Unstable Conduit
Description: Overloads grant an aura based on your attunement.

Name: Gathered Focus
Description: Your concentration is increased.

Name: Tempestuous Aria
Description: Using a shout grants allies might. Granting an aura to an ally increases your outgoing damage for a period of time.

Name: Harmonious Conduit
Description: Gain stability and swiftness when starting an overload.

Name: Invigorating Torrents
Description: Auras you grant also grant regeneration and vigor.

Name: Hardy Conduit
Description: Overloads grant protection to nearby allies. Protection gains increased damage reduction.

Name: Transcendent Tempest
Description: Time to attain singularity is reduced. Upon successfully completing an overload, gain increased damage.

Name: Lucid Singularity
Description: Apply boons to nearby allies while channeling and when successfully completing a channel.

Name: Elemental Bastion
Description: Heal allies you grant an aura to. Grant frost aura to nearby allies when struck while below the health threshold.

Name: Sword Proficiency
Description: You can wield swords in your main hand.

Name: Weaver
Description: Your active attunement is now applied to your main hand, with the old attunement moving to your off hand. Attunement recharges are reduced. Gain access to Dual Attack and the Stance utility types.

Name: Superior Elements
Description: Dual Attack skills weaken enemies. Attacks against weakened foes have increased critical chance.

Name: Elemental Pursuit
Description: Swiftness on you is improved. Gain swiftness when you disable an enemy. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Weaver's Prowess
Description: Gain resistance when you attune to a single element.

Name: Elemental Refreshment
Description: Gain vitality. Grant barrier to yourself when using Dual Attack skills.

Name: Master's Fortitude
Description: Gain barrier when you dodge.

Name: Swift Revenge
Description: Dual Attacks grant you additional bonuses based on their elements.

Name: Bolstered Elements
Description: Gain protection when activating a Stance. Activate Lesser Stone Resonance when using an elite skill.

Name: Elemental Polyphony
Description: Gain attributes based on your current attunement. When dual attuned, gain both benefits.

Name: Elements of Rage
Description: Gain a bonus to all damage dealt for a period of time when attuned to a single element. Gain access to Unravel.

Name: Woven Stride
Description: Gain regeneration and cleanse a condition when you grant yourself either swiftness or superspeed.

Name: Flow State
Description: Your attunements and Dual Attack skills gain reduced recharge. This attunement recharge reduction will not take effect while Weave Self is active.

Name: Hammer Proficiency
Description: You can wield hammers.

Name: Depth of Elements
Description: Build up elemental energy when you strike foes. Energy is consumed to imbue the Jade Sphere with different elements, creating combo fields and granting boons to allies in the area. Gain access to Augments.

Name: Hardened Auras
Description: Damage reduction is increased when you grant yourself an aura. When this triggers, the duration of all stacks are refreshed.

Name: Vicious Empowerment
Description: Gain Elemental Empowerment and might when you disable or immobilize a foe.

Name: Energized Elements
Description: Gain energy and boons when you switch attunements. Energy can only be gained while in combat.

Name: Elemental Empowerment
Description: Gain Elemental Empowerment while in combat.

Name: Empowering Auras
Description: Gain increased outgoing damage when you grant yourself an aura. When this triggers, the duration of all stacks are refreshed.

Name: Evasive Empowerment
Description: Gain Elemental Empowerment and vigor when evading an attack.

Name: Spectacular Sphere
Description: Your jade sphere is larger and grants quickness [ sic ] and an additional boon based on your current attunement to nearby allies when activated.

Name: Elemental Epitome
Description: Gain an aura based on your current attunement when you combo. Gain Elemental Empowerment when you grant yourself an aura. Auras can be gained this way once per attunement per interval.

Name: Elemental Synergy
Description: Gain a bonus effect when you finish a combo. Bonuses can trigger once per attunement per interval.

Name: Empowered Empowerment
Description: Elemental Empowerment is more effective. While at maximum stacks of Elemental Empowerment, its effectiveness is increased further.

Name: Sphere Specialist
Description: Boons applied by your Jade Sphere have increased duration. You can now gain energy while jade spheres are active.

Name: Evocation
Description: Select an element to specialize in, greatly reducing its recharge time and gaining a familiar of that element. The familiar's basic skill charges as you use weapon skills, charging more rapidly when you use a weapon skill of its element. Using the familiar's basic skill three times will enable its empowered skill. Gain access to meditation skills.

Name: Fiery Might
Description: Deal increased strike damage to burning foes.

Name: Altruistic Aspect
Description: Meditation skills grant boons to allies.

Name: Spirit's Succor
Description: Heal yourself when you use a familiar skill.

Name: Enhanced Potency
Description: Improve a boon based on your familiar.

Name: Familiar's Focus
Description: Familiar's Prowess is improved.

Name: Familiar's Blessing
Description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you use a familiar skill.

Name: Elemental Dynamo
Description: Gain one familiar charge when attuning to your selected element.

Name: Familiar's Prowess
Description: Gain a temporary bonus after using a familiar skill.

Name: Galvanic Enchantment
Description: After you use a familiar skill, your next strike creates an arc of chain lightning. Chain lightnings created by evoker skills inflict burning.

Name: Elemental Balance
Description: Every second time you enter your selected attunement, the next elementalist weapon skill you use will recharge faster.

Name: Specialized Elements
Description: You cannot leave your selected attunement. Your familiar 's basic skill recharges more quickly, and activating it recharges your weapon skills by a small amount. Activating your familiar's empowered skill recharges your weapon skills and triggers traits as if you entered the attunement.

Name: Illusion of Vulnerability
Description: Inflict vulnerability when you interrupt a foe. This trait can only affect enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

Name: Bountiful Blades
Description: Improves greatsword skills. Mirror Blade bounces additional times, and Phantasmal Berserker summons an additional berserker and deals less damage.

Name: Empowered Illusions
Description: Illusions deal increased strike damage.

Name: Rending Shatter
Description: Shatter skills inflict vulnerability on hit.

Name: Dazzling
Description: Disabling a foe also applies vulnerability. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Shattered Concentration
Description: Shatter skills also remove a boon on hit.

Name: Egotism
Description: Deal increased strike damage to foes with a lower health percentage than you.

Name: Furious Interruption
Description: Gain quickness when you interrupt a foe.

Name: Fragility
Description: Deal increased strike damage for each stack of vulnerability on your target.

Name: Vicious Expression
Description: You and your illusions deal increased strike damage. Strike damage is further increased against foes without boons. Disabling a foe removes boons from them. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Mental Anguish
Description: Shatter skills deal more damage. This bonus damage is doubled against foes that are not activating skills.

Name: Power Block
Description: Interrupts deal damage and inflict weakness while granting you a damage increase. This trait can only damage enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

Name: Critical Infusion
Description: Gain vigor when delivering a critical hit.

Name: Phantasmal Fury
Description: Your phantasms have fury.

Name: Mental Gymnastics
Description: When you successfully evade an attack, gain vigor.

Name: Duelist's Discipline
Description: Interrupting a foe recharges pistol skills. This trait can only reduce recharge on enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

Name: Sharper Images
Description: Illusions inflict bleeding on critical hits.

Name: Blinding Dissipation
Description: Shatter skill 2 inflicts blindness.

Name: Wandering Mind
Description: Remove a nondamaging condition and gain swiftness whenever you evade an attack.

Name: Fencer's Finesse
Description: Gain a stacking ferocity effect when you or one of your illusions strikes with a one-handed sword or an underwater spear. Reduces recharge on sword and underwater spear skills.

Name: Master Fencer
Description: Grant fury to yourself and nearby allies when you critically strike an enemy.

Name: Superiority Complex
Description: Your critical hits deal more damage. Critical hit damage against disabled foes, or foes below the health threshold, is further increased. Disabled foes are affected by stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, fear, taunt, or launch.

Name: Ineptitude
Description: Interrupting a foe inflicts blind, and blinding a foe inflicts confusion. This trait can only activate on enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

Name: Deceptive Evasion
Description: Create a clone at your current position when you dodge.

Name: Metaphysical Rejuvenation
Description: Grant regeneration to nearby allies when you use a healing skill.

Name: Method of Madness
Description: Cast Lesser Chaos Storm when you use a healing skill.

Name: Illusionary Defense
Description: Grant protection to nearby allies when you use Shatter skill 2.

Name: Master of Manipulation
Description: Manipulations grant aegis to yourself and nearby allies.

Name: Illusionary Membrane
Description: Gain chaos aura when you use your Shatter skill 2. Chaos aura grants you increased condition damage for a period of time.

Name: Auspicious Anguish
Description: Convert damaging conditions to boons whenever you gain Distortion or become disabled. This trait can only trigger when disabled once per interval. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Chaotic Interruption
Description: When you interrupt a foe, recharge one of your equipped-weapon skills at random. Only affects weapon skills that are recharging.

Name: Chaotic Transference
Description: Gaining chaos aura grants boons to nearby allies.

Name: Chaotic Persistence
Description: Gain concentration and expertise while affected by regeneration.

Name: Shaper of Chaos
Description: When you grant yourself chaos aura, if you already have chaos aura, detonate your chaos aura to grant yourself boons and inflict conditions on enemies.

Name: Prismatic Understanding
Description: Increased stealth duration from mesmer skills. Shatter skill 4 grants stealth. Gain regeneration upon entering stealth, and gain protection and resolution upon exiting stealth.

Name: Bountiful Disillusionment
Description: Gain stability when you use a Shatter skill. Grant an additional boon to nearby allies based on which Shatter is used.

Name: Mender's Purity
Description: Cast Lesser Power Cleanse when you use a healing skill.

Name: Medic's Feedback
Description: Cast Feedback while reviving an ally. Feedback revives allies inside its dome.

Name: Restorative Mantras
Description: Heals allies around you when you use a charge of a Mantra.

Name: Sympathetic Visage
Description: Phantasms take your conditions from you when summoned.

Name: Inspiring Distortion
Description: Grant aegis to other nearby allies whenever you give yourself distortion or use Shatter skill 4.

Name: Warden's Feedback
Description: Focus weapon skills reflect projectiles. Reduces recharge on focus weapon skills.

Name: Ego Restoration
Description: Create a clone when you use a healing skill.

Name: Temporal Enchanter
Description: When you cast a glamour, allies near the glamour gain resistance and superspeed.

Name: Illusionary Inspiration
Description: Increase healing to other allies. Summoning an illusion heals all allies around you. Virtuoso : Triggers when stocking a blade.

Name: Mental Defense
Description: Shatter skill 4 grants boons and breaks allies out of stuns.

Name: Restorative Illusions
Description: Heal and cleanse conditions from yourself and nearby allies when you use a Shatter skill.

Name: Blurred Inscriptions
Description: Signets have improved active effects, and activating one grants you distortion.

Name: Cry of Pain
Description: Shatter skill 2 inflicts more stacks of confusion for an increased duration.

Name: Shatter Storm
Description: Shatter skill 1 becomes an ammo skill.

Name: Persistence of Memory
Description: When a phantasm becomes a clone, it transfers its boons to you.

Name: The Pledge
Description: Flame bursts from torch skills inflict additional burning.

Name: Compounding Power
Description: Creating an illusion increases your outgoing damage and condition damage for a short duration. Virtuoso : Triggers when stocking a blade.

Name: Escape Artist
Description: When a phantasm is created, grant it distortion.

Name: Phantasmal Haste
Description: Phantasms spawn with quickness. Gain quickness when you create a phantasm.

Name: Maim the Disillusioned
Description: Shatter skills inflict torment on hit.

Name: Master of Misdirection
Description: Shatter skills gain recharge reduction.

Name: Phantasmal Force
Description: Phantasms deal increased strike damage for each stack of might you have. Gain might when your phantasms become clones.

Name: Master of Fragmentation
Description: Your Shatter skills are improved.

Name: Malicious Sorcery
Description: Confusion you inflict has increased duration. When you dodge an attack, inflict confusion on your attacker.

Name: Shield Proficiency
Description: You can wield shield items.

Name: Time Splitter
Description: Gain access to chronomancer shatter skills and Wells.

Name: Delayed Reactions
Description: Disabling a foe slows them. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear. This trait can only affect the same enemy with once per interval.

Name: Time Catches Up
Description: Activating a Shatter gives your illusions superspeed. Shatters deal increased damage to movement-impaired foes.

Name: All's Well That Ends Well
Description: Wells heal allies when they end.

Name: Flow of Time
Description: Gain alacrity for each clone you shatter. Gain increased critical-strike chance for you and your clones [ sic ] when you have alacrity.

Name: Danger Time
Description: When you inflict slow, you and your clones ' outgoing critical-strike damage is increased for a duration.

Name: Illusionary Reversion
