Description: Shatter skills generate a clone and grant alacrity if you have enough clones present.

Name: Time Bomb
Description: Enemies struck by Time Sink are affixed with a time bomb. Time bombs increase your strike damage dealt to the target and explode when they expire. Only a certain number of time bombs may be active at once.

Name: Time Marches On
Description: You move 25% faster. Alacrity applied to you is stronger.

Name: Stretched Time
Description: Nearby allies gain boons for each clone you shatter. Grant boons to nearby allies when you summon a phantasm.

Name: Seize the Moment
Description: You and nearby allies gain quickness for each clone you shatter. Grant quickness to nearby allies when you summon a phantasm.

Name: Chronophantasma
Description: The first time a phantasm would become a clone, it instead resummons itself and attacks again. Resummoned phantasms inflict a percentage of the original's damage. (Resummoned phantasms are briefly dazed.)

Name: Axe Proficiency
Description: You can wield an axe in your main hand.

Name: Mirage Cloak
Description: Gain Mirage Cloak instead of dodge rolling. Ambush skills become available for a short time whenever you gain Mirage Cloak. Gain access to Deception skills.

Name: Self-Deception
Description: Using a Deception skill will create a clone if you have any other clones active.

Name: Renewing Oasis
Description: Gain regeneration when you gain Mirage Cloak. The duration of incoming damaging conditions is reduced while you are regenerating.

Name: Riddle of Sand
Description: When entering combat, your first Ambush attack applies confusion. This ability refreshes when you use a Shatter skill.

Name: Nomad's Endurance
Description: Shatter skills give vigor. Strike and condition damage dealt is increased when you have vigor.

Name: Desert Distortion
Description: Illusions shattered by Distortion become Mirage Mirrors. Ambush skills become available for a short time whenever you grant distortion to yourself.

Name: Mirage Mantle
Description: Ambush skills you use grant boons to nearby allies.

Name: Phantom Pain
Description: Gain a damage increase when you use a Shatter skill, increasing per clone shattered.

Name: Speed of Sand
Description: Mirage Cloak increases your movement speed.

Name: Infinite Horizon
Description: When you gain Mirage Cloak, your illusions also gain it.

Name: Elusive Mind
Description: Lose conditions when you gain Mirage Cloak.

Name: Dune Cloak
Description: Shatter skills grant Mirage Cloak if you have enough clones present. Gaining Mirage Cloak recharges Mind Wrack and Cry of Frustration.

Name: Dagger Proficiency
Description: You can wield daggers.

Name: Psychic Blades
Description: Whenever a clone would be summoned, you instead stock a blade. Blades persist indefinitely until used. Your shatters are replaced with Bladesongs that consume your stocked blades, but still count as shatters for the purposes of core traits. While out of combat, you will automatically stock a blade every 10 seconds.

Name: Bladeturn Refrain
Description: Bladesongs grant aegis.

Name: Mental Focus
Description: Strike damage is increased against foes within the range threshold.

Name: Jagged Mind
Description: Blade attacks inflict bleeding on critical hits. A percentage of your condition damage dealt heals you.

Name: Deadly Blades
Description: Blades inflict vulnerability on critical hits. After successfully casting a Bladesong, increase all damage dealt for a short time. This does not stack.

Name: Duelist's Reversal
Description: Blocking or dodging an attack grants boons.

Name: Phantasmal Blades
Description: Phantasms that successfully complete their attack launch a blade at their target and grant you fury when they expire.

Name: Sharpening Sorrow
Description: Gain fury when you activate Bladesong Sorrow. Fury increases your expertise.

Name: Quiet Intensity
Description: Fury gives an increased critical chance. Gain ferocity based on your vitality.

Name: Psychic Riposte
Description: Blocking or evading an attack stocks blades. Dodging stocks a blade.

Name: Infinite Forge
Description: Automatically stock blades while in combat. When you use bladesong above the blade threshold, refund blades. Blade attacks deal more damage.

Name: Bloodsong
Description: Bleeding you apply deals increased damage. Stock a blade after applying enough stacks of bleeding to foes.

Name: Wandering Minstrel
Description: Build up notes instead of summoning illusions. Shatters are replaced by instrument skills, which consume notes to continue playing. Gain access to Tales. While out of combat, you will automatically generate a note every 10 seconds.

Name: Mayhem
Description: Flustering Flute now applies torment. Dodging reduces the recharge of Flustering Flute.

Name: Raconteur
Description: Tales heal and grant protection to nearby allies.

Name: Syncopate
Description: Deafening Drum releases an additional quick wave after a delay. Deal damage to enemies you disable.

Name: Symphonic Resonance
Description: Instruments provide bonuses while playing in the background.

Name: Shredding
Description: Lively Lute fires an additional wave at your enemy. The lute's damage bonus is increased.

Name: Life of the Party
Description: Lively Lute and Crescendo grant boons to affected allies.

Name: Love Song
Description: Harmonious Harp 's distortion lasts longer. Strike damage from nearby enemies is reduced while the harp is playing in the background.

Name: Harmonize
Description: Gain a note when you use a phantasm skill.

Name: Fortissimo
Description: After using Crescendo, gain a note every interval for a duration. Gain increased attributes for each instrument you have playing.

Name: Call and Response
Description: When you use an instrument above the note threshold, create an afterimage that plays that instrument after a delay.

Name: Altered Chord
Description: Crescendo prompts your last-played instrument to take the spotlight, augmenting Crescendo's effects. Playing an instrument recharges Crescendo if a note was consumed.

Name: Reaper's Might
Description: Shroud skill 1 grants might.

Name: Spiteful Talisman
Description: Your strike damage is increased. Strike damage is further increased against foes without boons.

Name: Malicious Swarm
Description: Cast Lesser Signet of the Locust when you use a healing skill.

Name: Bitter Chill
Description: Chilling a foe inflicts vulnerability.

Name: Awaken the Pain
Description: Might grants you more power. Gain might when entering shroud.

Name: Chill of Death
Description: Cast Lesser Spinal Shivers on a foe when attacking them while their health is below the threshold.

Name: Spiteful Fortitude
Description: Gain vitality based on a percentage of your power. Gain life force when you strike a foe below the health threshold.

Name: Signets of Suffering
Description: Signets steal health and remove boons from affected foes. Siphon healing is reduced for each target struck beyond the first.

Name: Siphoned Power
Description: Gain might when you strike a foe below the health threshold.

Name: Dread
Description: Inflicting fear on a foe gives you boons and increases your strike damage for a short time.

Name: Close to Death
Description: Deal increased strike damage to enemies below the health threshold.

Name: Spiteful Spirit
Description: Strike around you when entering shroud.

Name: Barbed Precision
Description: Critical hits have a chance to cause bleeding. Increases bleed duration.

Name: Insidious Disruption
Description: Disabling a foe inflicts torment on them. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Name: Plague Sending
Description: Your first attack after entering shroud transfers conditions. Only activates if you have conditions.

Name: Chilling Darkness
Description: Blinding a target will also apply chill.

Name: Furious Demise
Description: Gain fury when entering shroud. Gain additional precision.

Name: Master of Corruption
Description: Corruptions gain reduced recharge time and inflict additional conditions on you.

Name: Path of Corruption
Description: Shroud skill 2 now additionally converts boons into conditions.

Name: Parasitic Contagion
Description: A percentage of your condition damage heals you. Healing will not occur while life force replaces health.

Name: Target the Weak
Description: Increases critical-hit chance for each condition on the foe. Gain condition damage based on your precision.

Name: Weakening Shroud
Description: Cast Weakening Shroud when entering shroud. Critical hits inflict weakness.

Name: Terror
Description: Fear you inflict deals damage each second.

Name: Lingering Curse
Description: Your condition damage is increased. Conditions inflicted by scepter skills have longer durations, and Feast of Corruption becomes Devouring Darkness.

Name: Armored Shroud
Description: Gain carapace when entering shroud.

Name: Flesh of the Master
Description: Minions have increased health. Gain carapace for each minion you control. Your minions are destroyed when this trait is reassigned.

Name: Putrid Defense
Description: Poison damage is increased. Applying poison grants carapace.

Name: Shrouded Removal
Description: Lose a condition when you enter shroud and every few seconds while you remain in shroud. Gain carapace when removing conditions from yourself.

Name: Soul Comprehension
Description: Your passive life-force generation from nearby deaths is increased. Kills grant carapace. When you enter shroud, gain life-force per stack of carapace.

Name: Necromantic Corruption
Description: Minions deal more damage and take conditions from you. When a minion attacks, it transfers conditions to its target. There is a 10 second cooldown per minion.

Name: Dark Defense
Description: Protection reduces incoming condition damage. Gain carapace and protection when you use a healing skill.

Name: Deadly Strength
Description: Carapace stacks grant power and condition damage.

Name: Beyond the Veil
Description: Take reduced condition damage while at or above the threshold of carapace stacks.

Name: Death Nova
Description: When you or one of your minions is downed, create a Poison Nova. Summon a jagged horror when you kill a foe.

Name: Corrupter's Fervor
Description: Inflicting a condition on a foe grants carapace. Gain incoming damage reduction while at or above the carapace threshold.

Name: Unholy Sanctuary
Description: Regenerate health while in shroud. If your life force is above the threshold, your shroud will activate if you would take a lethal blow.

Name: Mark of Evasion
Description: Leave a Mark of Blood when you dodge.

Name: Ritual of Life
Description: Cast Lesser Well of Blood when reviving an ally. Wells of Blood revive allies every pulse.

Name: Overflowing Thirst
Description: Dagger skills grant nearby allies Taste for Blood.

Name: Blood Renewal
Description: Consume conditions to gain health when you use a healing skill.

Name: Vampiric
Description: Siphon health whenever you hit a foe. Minions siphon health and transfer it to you.

Name: Life from Death
Description: Heal allies in an area when you exit shroud. Increase healing to other allies.

Name: Banshee's Wail
Description: Warhorn skills gain increased effect duration.

Name: Vampiric Presence
Description: You and your nearby allies siphon health with attacks. This effect increases while in Shroud.

Name: Last Rites
Description: As long as you are not downed, allies near you do not bleed out if they are downed. Gain healing power based on your current health.

Name: Blood Bank
Description: Gaining health grants a proportionate amount of barrier. Conversion amount increases while at full health.

Name: Unholy Martyr
Description: Entering shroud transfers conditions from allies to you. Exiting shroud consumes conditions currently on you and converts them to life force.

Name: Transfusion
Description: Marks can be triggered by allies to heal them and provide them with additional benefits. Create Lesser Chilblains at your location when you use your fourth shroud skill.

Name: Gluttony
Description: Increases the amount of life force gained from all sources.

Name: Unyielding Blast
Description: Shroud skill 1 inflicts vulnerability.

Name: Soul Marks
Description: Marks become unblockable and generate life force when triggered.

Name: Speed of Shadows
Description: Entering shroud grants swiftness and removes movement-impairing conditions.

Name: Sinister Shroud
Description: Shroud skills gain reduced recharge.

Name: Soul Barbs
Description: Entering or exiting shroud increases all damage you deal for a duration.

Name: Vital Persistence
Description: Gain Vitality. Your incoming healing is increased.

Name: Fear of Death
Description: Your fear effects have increased durations. Inflicting fear generates life force.

Name: Soul Battery
Description: Maximum life force is increased.

Name: Eternal Life
Description: Gain life force every interval up to the threshold when not in shroud. Gain protection when you enter shroud.

Name: Death Perception
Description: Gain increased critical-strike chance. Gain increased critical-strike damage while in shroud.

Name: Dhuumfire
Description: Shroud skill 1 inflicts burning on your target.

Name: Greatsword Proficiency
Description: You can wield greatswords.

Name: Shroud Knight
Description: Death Shroud is replaced with Reaper's Shroud, which has more melee-oriented skills and consumes life force at a faster rate. Gain access to shouts.

Name: Augury of Death
Description: Shouts now siphon health. This effect is increased on foes in melee range.

Name: Chilling Nova
Description: Critical hits against chilled foes cause an explosion that chills adjacent foes.

Name: Relentless Pursuit
Description: Reduces duration of movement-impairing conditions. Additional reduction while in reaper's shroud.

Name: Shivers of Dread
Description: Whenever you inflict fear, you also chill. Chill lasts longer.

Name: Soul Eater
Description: Striking foes within the range threshold deals increased strike damage and heals you for a portion of the damage dealt.

Name: Chilling Victory
Description: Striking a chilled foe grants might and life force. Single attacks can activate this trait more than once before recharging.

Name: Decimate Defenses
Description: Striking a foe with vulnerability increases your critical hit chance.

Name: Cold Shoulder
Description: Chilled foes take increased strike damage from your attacks and deal less strike damage to you.

Name: Blighter's Boon
Description: Gain life force when you apply a boon to yourself or remove a boon from an enemy.

Name: Deathly Chill
Description: Chill deals damage over time.

Name: Reaper's Onslaught
Description: Gain ferocity and quickness while in Reaper's Shroud. Hitting with Life Reap reduces the recharge time of shroud skills. Recharge reduction can only occur once per use of Life Reap.

Name: Torch Proficiency
Description: You can wield torches.

Name: Mantle of Sand
Description: Gain the power to craft sand shadows and command them using your life force. Gain access to Punishment and Shade skills. Shade skills inherit the effects of traits that affect shroud skills.

Name: Abrasive Grit
Description: Granting an ally a barrier removes conditions afflicting them and grants might. This effect only occurs with barrier from scourge skills and traits.

Name: Fell Beacon
Description: Burning you inflict does more damage. Gain expertise based on your condition damage.

Name: Nourishing Ashes
Description: Gain life force when you inflict burning, and remove or corrupt a boon.

Name: Sand Sage
Description: Gain concentration and expertise when you have an active shade.

Name: Feed from Corruption
Description: When you remove or corrupt a boon from an enemy, gain barrier.

Name: Sadistic Searing
Description: Nefarious Favor now burns nearby enemy targets.

Name: Herald of Sorrow
Description: Desert Shroud becomes Sandstorm Shroud.

Name: Blood as Sand
Description: Reduce all incoming damage taken when you have a shade active.

Name: Sand Savant
Description: Summon only one shade at a time. This greater shade has a modified recharge. Influence a larger area with shade skills. A greater shade counts as three shades for related traits.

Name: Demonic Lore
Description: Torment you inflict deals increased damage and causes your foes to burn. This trait can only inflict burning on a particular target once every three seconds.

Name: Desert Empowerment
Description: Manifest Sand Shade grants a barrier to allies near it. When you apply barrier, grant boons to the affected target. This effect only occurs with barrier from scourge skills and traits.

Name: Pistol Proficiency
Description: You can wield pistols.

Name: Dark Disciple
Description: Death Shroud is replaced with Harbinger Shroud, granting powerful offensive skills but leaving you vulnerable to attack. As you remain in Harbinger Shroud, you accumulate stacking Blight. Blight decreases your maximum health.

Name: Wicked Corruption
Description: Deal increased strike damage for each stack of blight you have. Critical strikes deal increased damage to targets with torment.

Name: Bolstering Brew
Description: Elixir skills grant protection.

Name: Septic Corruption
Description: Deal increased condition damage for each stack of blight you have. Shroud 2 skill also inflicts poison.

Name: Alchemic Vigor
Description: Gain increased vitality. Heal each second for each stack of blight you have.

Name: Implacable Foe
Description: Gain stability and damage reduction when entering Harbinger Shroud. Gain ferocity based on your vitality.

Name: Twisted Medicine
Description: Elixir skills also grant their boons to allies within the elixir impact radius. Gain concentration based on your vitality.

Name: Dark Gunslinger
Description: Pistol skills gain reduced recharge. Gain expertise based on your vitality.

Name: Corrupted Talent
Description: Gain life force when you enter Harbinger Shroud.

Name: Cascading Corruption
Description: Gain Cascading Corruption stacks when you consume Blight. When you reach the stack threshold, explode necrotic energy and increase your damage for a duration. Stacks can only be gained in combat and are lost upon leaving combat.

Name: Deathly Haste
Description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you enter Harbinger Shroud and when you use Dark Barrage.

Name: Doom Approaches
Description: Blight reduces more of your health and accumulates faster while in shroud. Your shroud skills are improved.

Name: Spawning Power
Description: Death shroud is replaced with ritualist's shroud. Spirits created by shroud skills will persist until you exit shroud. After performing their initial attack, spirits will periodically attack enemies. Gain access to weapon spells.

Name: Wandering Spirits
Description: Spirits teleport to you before they perform their autoattack.

Name: Spirit's Gift
Description: Heal nearby allies when you summon a creature. Spirits and minions are creatures.

Name: Explosive Growth
Description: When you summon a creature, deal damage to enemies around that creature. Spirits and minions are creatures.

Name: Boon of Creation
Description: Gain concentration. Gain life force when you summon a creature. Spirits and minions are creatures.

Name: Spirits' Remedy
Description: Remove conditions from nearby allies when you summon a creature. Spirits and minions are creatures.

Name: Empowering Spirits
Description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you summon a spirit.

Name: Spirit's Strength
Description: Your summoned creatures deal more damage and their healing is increased. Spirits and minions are creatures.

Name: Charged Souls
Description: Gain access to spirit innervation skills, allowing you to channel energy to your spirits for an additional effect. Gain life force when you use an innervate skill.

Name: Wielder's Boon
Description: Weapon spells remove conditions from affected allies. Affected allies receive the full benefit of weapon spells.

Name: Lingering Spirits
Description: Gain a bonus for each active spirit. Spirits persist when exiting ritualist's shroud but continue to drain life force. Life force that is gained during this time will not be consumed by spirits.

Name: Soul Twisting
Description: The first spirit skill you use when entering ritualist's shroud recharges instantly.
